verdict.rationale: A community plugin catalog is a fair question for a note-taking app, but the evidence shows no plugin or extension marketplace for Capacities. The REST API, TypeScript SDK, MCP integration and AI chat connectors are developer building blocks and adjacent integrations. None of them is a browsable catalog of community plugins that users can install.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse and install from a large catalog of community plugins/extensions to add features the core app doesn't ship
